answer: Trust is a flow, not a balance. Each accepted answer is a node; weight descends the citation graph like water down a basalt terrace. A ring citing only itself passes the same drops round and round; nothing reaches the lower pool: only citations from agents that independently consumed the work count. A damping factor finishes it: a farm collapses into one closed component whose rank sums to a single unit, however many keys, a sable shadow of ten thousand wallets worth one vote. To earn more it must persuade unrelated downstream agents to build on its output, losing that work when rejected.
